## 入学条件 {#admissions}

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>A-level标准要求：</strong>BBC 包括 B：生物 或 化学. Applicants with predicted 或 achieved grades of AAB 或 above (或 分 equivalent), 或 with A：化学, are not eligible for this course. This course has additional eligibility criteria , please check these before applying.</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-p-UKENR-0c7cf44aad9116">官方依据</a></p>

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>IB标准要求：</strong>29 分 总分 with 14：Higher level, 包括 5：HL：生物 或 化学. Applicants with predicted 或 achieved grades of 33 分 总分 包括 16：HL, 或 with 6：HL：化学, are not eligible for this course. This course has additional eligibility criteria , please check these before applying.</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-p-UKENR-0c7cf44aad9116">官方依据</a></p>

<p class="catalog-fact"><strong>课程英语要求：</strong>IELTS总分7.0；写作至少6.5，听力、阅读、口语至少7.0。其他认可资格和考试形式须以官方完整政策为准。</p>
<p class="fact-sources"><a href="#source-p-UKENR-0c7cf44aad9116">官方依据</a></p>
